adjudication.reason: Complete student payload exact-parity confirmed by postfreeze extraction. The stem asks for correct simplified repeating-decimal notation, so equal numeric value alone does not validate the notation. Compact notation places dots over the first and last digits of the repeating block; a one-digit block has one dot. ㄱ has an extra middle dot, ㄴ places a dot on the integer 2 and only the first fractional digit, while ㄷ and ㄹ follow endpoint-dot convention. Correct set is ㄷ, ㄹ, choice ⑤. This corrects the interpretation in the preserved original freeze.
